methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each provider's official pricing page on the accessed date. Where the official page returned 403/JS-only, a reputable 2026 pricing-comparison or review page was used as primary source and is flagged in that vendor's provenance; a second independent review site is recorded as corroboration. monthlyUsd records the month-to-month rate in USD; where only annual billing exists the annualized monthly rate is used and the month-to-month rate is noted. Transaction-fee-only platforms (no monthly subscription) are represented with a single plan at monthlyUsd 0. For usage-metered services the published unit rate is noted in the plan notes. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony vertical). HIPAA/BAA fields are null unless the vendor explicitly states compliance.

vendors.name: Gumroad
vendors.provenance: https://gumroad.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). No monthly subscription; Gumroad charges a percentage of every sale. Direct-link sales: 10% + $0.50 per transaction. Discover marketplace sales: 30% per transaction. Gumroad acts as Merchant of Record and handles global tax.

plans.name: Direct Sales
plans.notes: No monthly fee. 10% + $0.50 per transaction on all sales via your profile or direct links. Gumroad is Merchant of Record; global tax handled by platform as of January 2025.

plans.name: Discover Marketplace
plans.notes: No monthly fee. 30% per transaction when new customers find and buy through the Gumroad Discover marketplace. Higher rate covers marketplace customer acquisition.

vendors.name: Lemon Squeezy
vendors.provenance: https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/pricing returned HTTP 403 on 2026-06-14. Primary data sourced from ecommerce-platforms.com review (2026) and sellfy.com comparison article (2026): Lemon Squeezy operates as a Merchant of Record with a free plan and a 5% + $0.50 per-transaction fee. No monthly flat-rate subscription tiers were found across multiple review sources.

plans.name: Ecommerce (Free)
plans.notes: No monthly subscription fee. 5% + $0.50 per transaction (Merchant of Record fee). Lemon Squeezy handles tax compliance globally. Email marketing is an optional add-on (free up to 500 subscribers, paid beyond that).

vendors.name: Payhip
vendors.provenance: https://payhip.com/pricing returned HTTP 403 on 2026-06-14. Primary data sourced from bloggingwizard.com Payhip review (2026) and corroborated by ecommerce-platforms.com Payhip review (2026). Three tiers confirmed across both sources: Free ($0, 5% fee), Plus ($29, 2% fee), Pro ($99, 0% fee). All plans include unlimited products.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5% Payhip transaction fee on every sale. Unlimited products, courses, memberships, instant delivery, VAT/EU tax handling. Payment processor (Stripe/PayPal) fees additional.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 2% Payhip transaction fee on every sale. Unlimited products and revenue. All features included. Annual billing option not published separately.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 0% Payhip transaction fee. Unlimited products and revenue. All features included. Economical for sellers exceeding ~$5,000/mo in revenue. Annual billing option not published separately.

vendors.name: Podia
vendors.provenance: https://www.podia.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Three paid plans; no free forever tier (30-day free trial only). Mover charges a 5% Podia platform fee; Shaker and Earthquaker have 0% platform fee. Annual billing saves approximately 16.7% (billed as flat annual amounts: $500, $1,000, $1,800).

plans.name: Mover
plans.notes: Annual billing: $500/year ($41.67/mo, ~17% discount). 5% Podia platform transaction fee. Limits: 100 email subscribers, 50 products, 500 hosted videos, 25 community spaces.

plans.name: Shaker
plans.notes: Annual billing: $1,000/year ($83.33/mo, ~17% discount). 0% Podia platform fee. 500 email subscribers, 150 products, 1,000 videos, 100 spaces, 1 assistant seat, affiliate marketing, upsells, PayPal, Zapier.

plans.name: Earthquaker
plans.notes: Annual billing: $1,800/year ($150/mo, same rate annually). 0% Podia platform fee. 1,000 email subscribers, unlimited products, unlimited videos, unlimited spaces, unlimited assistant seats, affiliate marketing, upsells.

vendors.name: Sellfy
vendors.provenance: https://www.sellfy.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Three plans; no free forever tier (14-day free trial). 0% Sellfy transaction fees on all plans. Plans gated by annual sales volume cap: Starter $10k/yr, Business $50k/yr, Premium $200k/yr; 2% overage fee if cap exceeded without upgrading. Annual billing saves 25%.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Annual billing: $22/mo ($264/year). 0% Sellfy transaction fee. Up to $10k annual sales; 2% overage fee beyond cap. Physical, digital, subscription, and print-on-demand products. Payment processor (Stripe/PayPal) fees apply separately.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Annual billing: $59/mo ($708/year). 0% Sellfy transaction fee. Up to $50k annual sales; 2% overage fee beyond cap. Adds cart abandonment, upsell, email marketing tools.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Annual billing: $119/mo ($1,428/year). 0% Sellfy transaction fee. Up to $200k annual sales; 2% overage fee beyond cap or upgrade required. Priority support, full feature set. Custom Enterprise pricing above $200k (contact sales).

vendors.name: SendOwl
vendors.provenance: https://www.sendowl.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Three Creator plans; Business plans from $299/mo for higher volume. 0% SendOwl transaction fees on all plans. Plans limited by annual orders/sales volume and monthly bandwidth. Annual billing saves ~16.7% (2 months free). Bandwidth overage: $1/GB.

plans.name: Launch
plans.notes: Annual billing: $32.50/mo (2 months free, ~17% discount). 0% SendOwl transaction fee. 5,000 orders/year, $10k annual sales cap, 10 GB bandwidth/month. Bandwidth overage: $1/GB.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Annual billing: $72.50/mo (2 months free, ~17% discount). 0% SendOwl transaction fee. 25,000 orders/year, $36k annual sales cap, 20 GB bandwidth/month. Bandwidth overage: $1/GB.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Annual billing: $132.50/mo (2 months free, ~17% discount). 0% SendOwl transaction fee. 50,000 orders/year, $100k annual sales cap, 50 GB bandwidth/month. Bandwidth overage: $1/GB.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Business tier starts at $299/mo for up to $200k annual sales. Higher-volume plans available up to $5M+ annual revenue (contact sales). 0% SendOwl transaction fee.

vendors.name: Shopify
vendors.provenance: https://www.shopify.com/pricing returned EUR prices due to geolocation (accessed 2026-06-14). USD pricing sourced from ecommerce-platforms.com 2026 Shopify pricing article; corroborated by oberlo.com 2026 Shopify pricing guide. Plans: Basic $39/mo, Grow $105/mo, Advanced $399/mo, Plus from $2,300/mo. Annual billing saves 25%.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Social selling / link-in-bio plan. 5% + $0.30 transaction fee per sale. No full storefront; limited to buy buttons and social commerce integrations.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Annual billing: $29/mo. Online card rate: 2.9% + $0.30; in-person: 2.6% + $0.10. Third-party payment gateway surcharge: 2%. Full storefront, digital downloads, basic analytics, 2 staff accounts.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Annual billing: $79/mo. Online card rate: 2.7% + $0.30; in-person: 2.5% + $0.10. Third-party gateway surcharge: 1%. Formerly named 'Shopify'. 5 staff accounts, professional reports.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Annual billing: $299/mo. Online card rate: 2.5% + $0.30; in-person: 2.4% + $0.10. Third-party gateway surcharge: 0.6%. 15 staff accounts, advanced report builder, third-party calculated shipping.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Published starting rate $2,300/mo; actual price negotiated based on GMV (revenue-based pricing above certain thresholds). Third-party gateway surcharge: 0.2%. Dedicated account manager, custom checkout, B2B features, Shopify Audiences.
